description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to the Minute on Secretaries, w.e.f. 26.10.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the "Minute on Secretaries" concerning pension entitlements, seniority salary scales, and special allowances for Ministry Secretaries who lose their posts due to non-disciplinary reasons. It deals specifically with public service conditions, benefits, and retirement matters for government secretaries, falling under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than government structure/personnel types (1-3) as it focuses on administrative regulations for public officials rather than naming individuals or describing government portfolios.
